name: Topology Behavioral Distinction Registry
purpose: Prevent semantic collapse between topology behavioral categories before corridor, failure, and advanced orientation layers are expanded.
core_rule: Behavioral categories may interact operationally without becoming interchangeable primitives.

detects: behavioral categories recursively defined only in terms of each other
multiple primitives collapsing into a universal placeholder
corridor silently treated as unrestricted path
admissibility silently treated as guaranteed continuation

required_distinctions.difference: transition changes topology state classification; reconfiguration rearranges internal relations.
corridor is a constrained admissibility structure; path is a traversal instance.
orientation constrains admissibility directionality; transport describes traversal or propagation behavior.
failure is bounded structural degradation; invalidity violates governance or admissibility rules.
a boundary constrains continuation conditions; termination is cessation of admissible continuation.
admissibility defines allowed possibility conditions; continuation describes active persistence behavior.
